bayts.text: And take away forever what grieves my heart toward others than me, and perpetuate my gladness.
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon him who led the learned to You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And take away what grieves my heart, without its being turned toward me: let it go (elsewhere).
And write for me today the stations of the men (of God), O You Who lead noble offspring to me perpetually.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon my Intimate and my Beloved, the ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me in writing what belongs to no one, O You to Whom belongs "Be", and it is (Qurʾān 36:82).
And write for me today a guarded (gift) never seen by others than me, and by others than me it shall never be seen.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that leads a guide to me, that leads to me endlessly rightly-guided ones,
with a peace that for me tames the foolish, a taming by which You make them regret, O my Lord,
upon him whom You made the one I serve, O You Who through him bestowed pre-eminence on me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And through my writing subject to me all who do not love me: for You are the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ).
And grant me today a guarded (gift) that silences whoever is grieved by my pre-eminence: silence him.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that removes the hearts of those who do not love me toward others than me, O Possessor of the milk,
with a peace that takes away toward others than me what grieves me, forever, and it goes,
upon him who removed the envious toward others than me and warded off corruption.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And with You make me the glad tidings of the noble, O Everlasting Who have protected me without break.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that takes away turbidities toward a direction other than mine, and the treacherous,
and takes away what is sold from me forever toward other than my person, and what is not praised,
with a peace that makes glad tidings eternal for me, upon him whom You made the pride of humankind.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And convey my price to the Gardens for me, O Everlasting Who have been for me with safety.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that bestows mysteries on me and removes faults toward other than my heart,
with a peace that softens hearts for me without harm and makes the milk eternal for me,
upon him through whom You made my heart good, and bestowed on me generously by his hand.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him, in me, joys that last, O You Who through him made me his servant.
And grant my two parents, in filial piety, a joy that remains without delusion.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You bought from me all that was sold from me, without cancellation, and led a springtime to me (Qurʾān 9:111).
Bless with a blessing that makes the price eternal for me and conveys the glad tidings of time to me,
with a peace that makes clarity eternal for me, upon him who was described as "an ear of good" (Qurʾān 9:61).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn what is sold from me, forever, toward other than my person, and make the joy perpetual.
And make me today and after today abstinent from all that You have not approved for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You bought my wares from me and led their equivalent to me, and bestowed Your good pleasure on me.
Bless with a blessing that leads to me all that You chose for me, and teach my heart,
with a peace that takes away toward others than me every enemy and harm, and they go,
upon him who is gladdened by my abiding with the Book forever, and by my ascending.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my life a joy for the Prophet, O You Who through him spared me harm.
And make my piety toward my two parents reach them, as the best piety accomplished.
And make all that I have done as piety for my two parents the best striving and joy.
You enjoined on us goodness toward our parents (Qurʾān 29:8), O You Who made me a lofty servant.
Reward on my behalf my two parents with a good that multiplies, O Creator of what I willed, O Giver of effect.
By the right of Your noble Countenance purify my whole being, and make my heart skilful.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
